instrumentation: kick (sine sweep 120->50 Hz, tau 40 ms) on every beat; snare (noise burst + 185 Hz) on beats 2 and 4; closed hi-hat on every 8th; sustained 3-note chord pad, one chord per bar; no melody/bass
notes: beats[k] = first_beat + k*60/bpm (exact; onset sample = round(t*48000)). downbeats = beats 1 of each 4/4 bar. Digital silence until first_beat - 0.03 s, where the pad starts a 60 ms fade-in; the first kick is exactly at first_beat.
